Definition: properly, a net, i.e. (by analogy) lattice
BiblicalUsage: Cherek is a lattice, the openwork screen through which a lover watches, and it appears once in the Song of Songs. The beloved stands behind the wall looking through the windows, showing himself through the lattice, close at hand yet still partly hidden.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture is honest about love, which sees truly even when it does not yet see fully.
